description_en: Queries the statistics on SMS messages sent, including the sending time, the number of successfully sent messages, and the number of receipts received
description_zh: 查询短信发送统计详情，包括短信发送时间、短信发送成功条数、接收回执条数等
name: QuerySendStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The scope of SMS messages. Valid values:

1: domestic SMS sending records.

2: international or Chinese Hong Kong, Chinese Macao, or Chinese Taiwan SMS sending records
parameters.help_zh:
短信发送范围。取值：

1：国内短信发送记录。

2：国际/港澳台短信发送记录
parameters.name: is_globe

parameters.help_en: The start date in the yyyyMMdd format
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date in the yyyyMMdd format
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数。取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The templatetype. Valid values:

0: authenticate code.

1: notification.

2: promotional message. (Only enterprise users are supported.)

3: international or Chinese Hong Kong, Chinese Macao, or Chinese Taiwan message. (Only enterprise users are supported.)

7: digital message
parameters.help_zh:
模板类型。取值：

0：验证码。

1：通知短信。

2：推广短信。（仅支持企业客户）

3：国际/港澳台消息。（仅支持企业客户）

7：数字短信
parameters.name: template_type
